window_binding.why_not_setfile: single-symbol Q09_NEWS rows carry the window in payload keys from_date/to_date/window_from_utc/window_to_utc; farmctl's spawn builder reads these (_basket_payload_date_window returns None for single symbols, hence the 2024 fallback). repair-oos-window injects them from the plan and stamps q09_dispatch_binding_sha256 + the campaign_plan sha the spawn re-verifies.

downstream_blockers_after_window_repair.detail: All 37 patched rows and the 15 minted successors keep phase=Q09_NEWS (historical). The active NEWS runner binds Q10_NEWS only; farmctl._news_lane_spawn_refusal returns pending_runner/news_lane_mismatch for Q09_NEWS rows and refuses to run them (never as run_smoke). => window repair does NOT make the cohort executable; a separate lane migration Q09_NEWS->Q10_NEWS is required. report-misphased-rows (misphased_rows.json) is the read-only surface for that disposition.

Standing containment rule (OPEN_ITEMS 2026-09-05): every dispatch tick holds NEW Q09_NEWS/Q10_NEWS rows with NEWS_CALENDAR_TIMESTAMP_DEFECT until E1 (tester-branch DST calendar repair, QM_NewsFilter.mqh:2022). As of 2026-09-13 the defect is still contained (12 active Q10_NEWS timestamp-defect holds; risk freeze ACTIVE). A correctly-windowed, correctly-laned row would be re-held under NEWS_CALENDAR_TIMESTAMP_DEFECT until E1 lands. Live path unaffected (native MT5 calendar, DL-080).
